# Taksh Patel

> Creating with code. Shipping the honest version.

Taksh Patel is an IT undergrad at GTU and a Full Stack Developer based in India. He focuses on building and shipping real products rather than portfolio fillers. Currently deep in Next.js (App Router, Server Actions, Server Components) and Redis, he has experience across modern web technologies, building scalable and interactive applications.

## Tech Stack

- **Core Frameworks**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript
- **Styling & Animation**: Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, Lenis, GSAP
- **Backend & Databases**: Redis, Node.js, Express.js, Firebase (Realtime Database), PostgreSQL, MongoDB
- **Tools & Utilities**: Git, ESLint, React PDF, Markdown (remark/rehype)

## Projects

Projects are dynamically managed and synced via Firebase. Here are some key highlights:

- **ComponentLabs**: 60+ open-source, ready-to-use, animated UI React components. (Live & Operational)
- **AI Code Reviewer**: An AI-powered code quality analysis tool using the Gemini API.
- **Link Shortener**: Full-stack URL shortening service.
- **Task Master**: Employee management and task assignment system.
- **FurnishHub**: Modern furniture e-commerce platform.
- **FinFlow**: Financial dashboard with interactive charts.
- **Terminal Portfolio**: An interactive CLI-style developer portfolio.
- **Movie App v2.0**: TMDB-powered responsive movie browsing application.

*Full list, live links, and repositories are available on the [Projects section](https://takshpatel.vercel.app/projects).*
